title: Ukrainian forces once more hit Russia's Crimean Bridge, days after devastating strike
summary: Sergey Aksyonov, the Moscow-installed head of Russian-occupied Crimea, confirmed the bridge had been hit again just after midnight local time.

title: 'Unacceptable attempt at intimidation' — Russian man charged with spying, targeting Silicon Valley
summary: Igor D'iu was instructed to carry out clandestine assignments targeting employees of a large Palo Alto, California, technology and defense company allegedly supplying weapons and systems to Ukraine for use against Russia.
